title: What You Feed Grows
devotional: What you repeatedly give your attention to can become stronger in your life. Your habits, thoughts, conversations, entertainment, and daily choices are all feeding something. If you continually feed an unhealthy pattern, it can become easier to repeat. But the same principle can work in a better direction. When you consistently feed your faith, discipline, wisdom, and healthy habits, those areas can become stronger too. Today, ask yourself what you are feeding and whether it is taking you toward the person God is calling you to become.
mind_check: What do you spend the most time feeding with your attention, and where is it taking you?
body_move: Replace one unhealthy activity today with a physical activity that strengthens your body or improves your environment.
spirit_move: Give intentional time to God's Word, prayer, or worship before giving your attention to unnecessary distractions.
way_out: If I want to grow in __________, I need to consistently feed it by __________.
prayer: Father, help me become aware of what I am feeding every day. Give me wisdom to reduce what weakens me and increase what strengthens my relationship with You. Help my habits, thoughts, and choices move me toward the person You want me to become. Amen.
action: Make two lists: 'What I Need to Feed' and 'What I Need to Stop Feeding.' Put at least three things under each list and choose one change to begin today.
